result.summary: The page is generally well-designed and functional, but there are a few visual issues: horizontally scrollable content (category chips and the 'Fastest near you' carousel) is clipped at the right edge without clear scroll affordance, and the bottom pizza card is cut off mid-image by the viewport. These are mostly minor/cosmetic, though the clipped carousel text could mildly hurt discoverability.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is clipped at the right edge: the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word with no visible scroll indicator or fade-out gradient to signal that more content is available by scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or peek of the next card, and/or a scroll indicator, so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable. Ensure card titles truncate with an ellipsis at a consistent width rather than cutting mid-word at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no visual cue that it scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade or ensure the next chip peeks into view to communicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off mid-image by the viewport bottom edge (above the tab bar), showing only the top portion of the image and no title/metadata, which looks like an incomplete render at this scroll position.
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for a scrollable feed, but consider adding bottom padding or a scroll snap so cards aren't awkwardly bisected when the list rests; alternatively ensure the feed scrolls fully so the card can be seen completely.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red dot badge with no text label or count, which may be unclear to screen-reader users and is a very small touch/visual target.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 unread') and ensure the badge meets minimum size/contrast guidelines.
